# Strictly Explicit Behavior

- NEVER make assumptions. If any variable, framework requirement, architecture choice, typing, edge case, or context is ambiguous or missing, STOP immediately.
- DO NOT generate code based on guesses or standard assumptions.
- ALWAYS ask direct clarifying questions to get the exact missing information before writing or modifying code.
- State clearly what information is missing and why it is needed to proceed.
- If multiple interpretations exist, list them as options and ask me to select one instead of picking one yourself.
